description: Source code for a byte buffer implementation, including memory pooling, buffer manipulation, and serialization functions.

classes.name: default_segment_pool_memory_resource
classes.description: Memory resource wrapper for the default byte buffer segment pool, handling allocation and deallocation.

classes.name: default_fallback_segment_pool_memory_resource
classes.description: Memory resource wrapper that falls back to heap allocation when the pool is depleted.

classes.name: byte_buffer::control_block
classes.description: Manages segments and memory for a byte buffer, including destruction and cleanup.

methods.name: byte_buffer::create
methods.description: Creates a byte buffer with a specified segment pool.

methods.name: byte_buffer::deep_copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the byte buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::append
methods.description: Appends data or another byte buffer to the current buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::add_head_segment
methods.description: Adds a new segment at the beginning of the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::create_segment
methods.description: Creates a new segment for the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::append_segment
methods.description: Appends a new segment to the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::prepend_segment
methods.description: Prepends a new segment to the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::pop_last_segment
methods.description: Removes the last segment from the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::trim_head
methods.description: Removes bytes from the beginning of the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::trim_tail
methods.description: Removes bytes from the end of the buffer.

methods.name: byte_buffer::linearize
methods.description: Converts the buffer into a contiguous memory block if not already contiguous.

methods.name: byte_buffer::resize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer to a specified size.
